pages.observed: Option a frames 0 to 24: empty cool-toned room with five wall cameras, an empty table under an overhead lamp, and a skyline window. Room unchanged across samples; a caption naming Houston Methodist appears at 0.6 s.
Option a 1.0 to 1.8 s: room lights up, tile grid fades in on back wall and floor, wall cameras tilt slightly. Table remains empty; no name plate visible yet. Caption sits mid-frame over the floor.

Option a 2.0 to 2.8 s: Texas outline locator draws top right; a small green-topped name plate reading Cardiothoracic suite / Houston Methodist appears on the back wall, its right end overlapped by a camera body and lamp. Table remains empty.

Option a 3.0 to 3.8 s: locator card completes Texas outline; cameras pivot slightly; at 3.8 s a modest push-in to the camera ring view with the second caption. Any camera status lamp is a pinpoint, not readable as lighting in turn at this size.
Option a 4.0 to 4.8 s: tiny amber status lamps light on the four wall cameras in sequence; dots are a few pixels at phone size. The room and empty table are otherwise unchanged; caption mid-frame.
Option a 5.0 to 5.8 s: same wide room, cameras swivel slightly with amber dots lit, locator card adds a ring near Houston. No patient, gurney or person yet; the table is empty.

Option a 6.0 to 6.8 s: cut at 6.2 s to a closer table view with two lit wall cameras and a soft-focus skyline window; at 6.6 s the end of a gurney carrying a small round head shape pokes into frame at the right edge by the doorway. No hands visible.

Option a 7.0 to 7.8 s: gurney with a draped patient shape and round head rests at the extreme right edge by the doorway, about one third visible; it barely moves across samples. No hands or attendant visible; empty table holds at left.

Option a 8.0 to 8.8 s: close view holds with gurney at right edge, then at 8.6 s a cut to the wide room where two small masked attendants in scrubs already stand at the empty table and the gurney waits in the doorway. Caption: The system timestamped.

Option a 9.0 to 9.8 s: a round wall clock draws on the tiled back wall left of the window and its hands sweep. Attendants stand idle at the empty table; gurney remains in the doorway. No markers on the clock yet.

Option a 10.0 to 10.8 s: close on the clock; a pulse mark flies to the rim and a Patient entry tag lands while a third attendant pushes the gurney through the doorway. At 10.8 s a cut to the wide room shows the patient already transferred to the table and two attendants passing a folded drape.

Option a 11.0 to 11.8 s: two attendants open and lay a teal drape over the patient; a Draped tag lands on the clock rim under Patient entry. At 11.8 s a split view: a camera emits a dotted pulse to the clock while, through the window, the draped patient is moved out at small scale.

Option a 12.0 to 12.8 s: in split view a camera pulse stamps Turnover on the clock as the draped patient exits at small scale through the window; fresh-sheet laying is not distinguishable. At 12.6 s a cut to a large blue gloved hand holding a dark phone, which begins to glow at 12.8 s.

Option a 13.0 to 13.8 s: phone in a blue gloved hand lights up with a header Text message and a To surgeon chip; a dotted amber arc runs from the wall camera to the phone. In the small blurred background the next patient is wheeled toward the table. Message body still blank.

Option a 14.0 to 14.8 s: phone stays lit with header and blank body before any draping occurs; background figures move the next patient onto the table. At 14.8 s cut to wide room with three attendants at the undraped patient and a small phone at lower left.

Option a 15.0 to 15.8 s: three attendants lay a teal drape over the patient in the wide room while a small phone sits at lower left. At 15.8 s cut to the close phone, still showing only Text message and To surgeon with a blank body; no patient draped text yet.

Option a 16.0 to 16.8 s: an amber text bubble reading Patient draped slides onto the phone screen and settles, with the draped patient visible small in the background. The gloved thumb partly overlaps the bubble's left edge. Caption clears at 16.8 s.

Option a 17.0 to 17.8 s: cut to a beige desk under a skyline window strip; a paper card titled Hospital study fades in and settles with empty chart axes and a dashed rule. An empty counter box labelled more surgeries a month already sits below. Legend text on the card is too small to read at phone size.
Option a 18.0 to 18.8 s: completely static desk frame; the study card with empty chart, the empty counter box and the caption do not change across all five samples.

Option a 19.0 to 19.8 s: static until a 19.4 s cut to a closer card; legend chips This suite and Cameras on become legible but the chart has no lines yet. Caption overlaps the lower edge of the empty counter box.

Option a 20.0 to 20.8 s: a solid teal line and a dashed gray line draw across the card side by side, nearly coincident, ending with labels This suite and Other Houston Methodist sites. Counter box still empty; caption overlaps its base.

Option a 21.0 to 21.8 s: static card with two flat, overlapping lines; at 21.6 s a cut to a closer detail of the line ends and the empty counter box. Caption 'and found about 25 more surgeries a month.' arrives at 21.8 s while the counter box is still empty and the lines have not separated.

Option a 22.0 to 22.8 s: after the Cameras on rule, the solid teal suite line climbs away from the flat dashed comparison line and the gap fills pale teal. The counter box below still shows no number.

Option a 23.0 to 23.8 s: the counter box begins filling with small teal tiles carrying a white icon, dropping along a dotted arc from the chart gap; about a dozen by 23.8 s. No numeral appears in the box yet.

Option a 24.0 to 24.8 s: the counter fills to a 5 by 5 grid of 25 teal tiles and a large teal 'about 25' appears beside 'more surgeries a month'. The chart above holds the separated suite and comparison lines.

Option a 25.0 to 25.8 s: cut to a wider desk where the counter card sits small in the upper third; a round teal '7% rise' badge stamps in large and settles beside it. Lower half of the frame is empty desk.
Option a 26.0 to 26.8 s: the wide desk frame holds with the small counter card, 'about 25' and 7% badge; only change is a faint glow around the tile card at 26.8 s. Lower half remains empty desk.
Option a 27.0 to 27.8 s: same wide desk frame; the glow around the counter card fades and nothing else moves. Caption clears at 27.8 s. No axis has appeared yet.
Option a 28.0 to 28.8 s: closer desk framing; under the counter and 7% badge a thin tick-marked axis draws across, labelled 95% confidence interval. Axis has no numbers yet and is thin at phone size.
Option a 29.0 to 29.8 s: fully static frame of the counter, 7% badge and an empty labelled axis; no whisker or numbers appear in these samples.
Option a 30.0 to 30.8 s: cut to a close axis; a teal end cap lands at 8.3 and a teal whisker grows to the right with a white circular tip. The 25 counter and 7% badge are now off screen.

Option a 31.0 to 31.8 s: the axis holds a teal whisker from 8.3 with a white circle near the middle and a faint lighter extension to the right; no right end cap or 41.0 appears in these samples. Frame largely static.
Option a 32.0 to 32.8 s: the right end cap lands at 41.0 and a 'cases a month' chip settles beneath the completed teal interval bar, which holds readable above the caption.

Option a 33.0 to 33.8 s: the interval holds, then a cut to a wide desk labelled Placebo test; small pale gray bars of varying heights begin rising from a baseline at left, occupying a small strip of the frame.

Option a 34.0 to 34.8 s: ten equal pale gray bars stand in a row labelled Placebo runs; a teal Suite bar rises at the right and slides in beside them at the same height. Bars occupy a narrow band mid-frame; sub-labels are tiny.

Option a 35.0 to 35.8 s: closer static view of equal-height bars with labels Placebo runs and Suite. No stamp has landed by 35.8 s; the caption carries the 'did not reach conventional significance' wording alone.

Option a 36.0 to 36.8 s: a large wooden stamp presses down and lifts, leaving a crooked amber 'SHORT OF CONVENTIONAL SIGNIFICANCE' impression across the bars; held about 0.4 s before a cut at 36.8 s to a wide desk with a Camera rollout tag.

Option a 37.0 to 37.8 s: a paper card reading 'Associated with the rollout' with a tiny Authors chip slides in from the left and settles above the Camera rollout tag on the desk. No counter is visible in this frame.

Option a 38.0 to 38.8 s: static card and tag, then a wider cut where the rollout tag sits left and a small tile counter with tiny 'about 25 more a month' sits right; a dash starts from the tag toward the counter. Elements are small at phone size.
Option a 39.0 to 39.8 s: a dashed teal arrow draws from the Camera rollout tag to the small tile counter and holds, with a tiny 'associated' label. The link and counter are small in the frame.

Option a 40.0 to 40.8 s: cut to a close view of the dashed 'associated' link reaching the 25-tile counter; the rollout tag is cropped off left. A solid black arrow labelled caused draws in from the left edge below the link; it does not yet touch the counter and has not been struck.

Option a 41.0 to 41.8 s: the solid caused arrow completes, its head overlapping the 'a month' label; a diagonal stroke then strikes through it and the arrow and word caused gray out, holding beside the dashed associated link.

Option a 42.0 to 42.8 s: the struck caused arrow holds about one second, then a cut to the wide desk where four note cards (Turnover review, Housekeeping review, Anesthesia review, Surgeon notices) sit under a Workflow changes heading.
Option a 43.0 to 43.8 s: the Camera rollout tag slides in from the left and settles against the stack of four workflow review cards. No band yet.

Option a 44.0 to 44.8 s: closer cut on the tag and notes; a tan band slides across and lands as a horizontal strip labelled Bundled over the Camera rollout tag and the Anesthesia review card, hiding the tag's label. It crosses one row rather than visibly wrapping the stack.

Option a 45.0 to 45.8 s: the tan Bundled band holds across the rollout tag and the middle card, with a buckle end added at right. The tag's own label stays hidden under the band. Caption clears at 45.8 s.

Option a 46.0 to 46.8 s: wide desk; at right a Camera company / Apella Technology tag, an empty gray ownership ring labelled Owners of the company and a Houston Methodist tag fade in. Text in the ring is small at phone size.
Option a 47.0 to 47.8 s: fully static wide desk; the ownership ring stays empty with no slice lit while the caption about the minority stake runs. Ring and tags occupy a small area at right.

Option a 48.0 to 48.8 s: cut to a close ownership ring; a small teal wedge lights on the ring and a dotted line links it to the Houston Methodist tag, with a Minority stake label fading in. No number is shown. The company tag is out of frame in this close.
Option a 49.0 to 49.8 s: the teal minority wedge, Minority stake label and dotted link to the Houston Methodist tag hold steady and legible above the caption.
Option a 50.0 to 50.8 s: ring holds, then a cut to an empty wide desk where a small paper card titled Future work lands, its highlighted first line reading Turnover time and two tiny lines below.
Option a 51.0 to 51.8 s: beside the Future work card a small room clock draws itself, with marker dots on its rim and a green Turnover tag at the bottom marker.

Option a 52.0 to 52.8 s: close on the clock with a green Turnover tag; the Future work card is cropped to a sliver at the left edge. A small green pin appears on that sliver with a short tail toward the clock; no complete link to the marker visible yet.

Option a 53.0 to 53.8 s: a dashed tether runs from the Future work card's pin to the clock's turnover marker. At 53.8 s a cut to a tiled wall panel holding a small clock with its Turnover tag, a lit wall camera and a result card carrying the rollout tag, dashed associated link and 25 counter.

Option a 54.0 to 54.8 s: a blank cream box headed 'Did the rollout speed up turnover?' draws beside the clock, linked by a dotted line from the turnover marker. The box and its heading collide with the wall camera at upper right. Result card remains below.
Option a 55.0 to 55.8 s: the wall panel holds unchanged with the empty question box, clock and result card; no visible pulse of the turnover marker is distinguishable in these samples.

Option a 56.0 to 56.8 s: the turnover marker glows softly on the panel; at 56.8 s a cut back to the wide room with the four lit cameras, the clock, the empty question box and a small result card set against the window, and an empty table.

Option a 57.0 to 57.8 s: wide empty room holds while the light lowers slightly; the four amber camera lamps stay lit, the question box stays blank and the small result card sits on the window. Result card text is tiny at phone size.
Option a 58.0 to 58.8 s: the dimmed wide room holds with lamps lit, blank question box and empty table; the closing caption clears at 58.8 s.
Option a 59.0 to 59.8 s: captionless static hold on the dimmed wide room, lit camera lamps, blank question box and empty table.
Option a 60.0 to 60.8 s: credits card fades in with the Lone Star flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, sources, illustration disclosure and music licence text.
Option a 61.0 to 61.8 s: unchanged credits card with Lone Star flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL and source, illustration and music credits.
Option a 62.0 to 62.8 s: the same credits card holds without change.
Option a 63.0 to 63.8 s: the credits card holds without change.
Option a 64.0 to 64.8 s: the credits card holds without change.
Option a final frame 1947 at 64.9 s: the credits card is unchanged, showing the flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL and the source, illustration and music credits.

Option b 0.0 to 0.8 s: a top-down floor plan of a gray room with four tiny camera icons, a central table and a doorway to a corridor at right occupies the upper half; the lower half is empty. No change across samples besides the caption.
Option b 1.0 to 1.8 s: the overhead plan holds; a soft glow brightens around the central table and the small camera icons rotate slightly. Lower half of the frame stays empty.

Option b 2.0 to 2.8 s: a Texas outline locator draws top right and a small name plate reading Cardiothoracic suite / Houston Methodist Hospital settles under the overhead plan. The plan itself is otherwise unchanged.

Option b 3.0 to 3.8 s: the overhead plan holds while the locator completes; at 3.8 s a cut to the perspective room interior showing four wall cameras, the name plate, an empty table and a skyline window, with the second caption.
Option b 4.0 to 4.8 s: the same wide room as option a's opening; small amber lamps light on the four cameras in sequence while the table stays empty. Lamps are a few pixels at phone size.
Option b 5.0 to 5.8 s: wide room with lit cameras swivelling slightly; the locator rings Houston. The table is empty and no patient or person has appeared.

Option b 6.0 to 6.8 s: cut at 6.2 s to a closer overhead plan; the wall camera icon swivels toward the doorway and at 6.8 s a small rounded gurney end appears in the corridor at the right edge. No hands visible.

Option b 7.0 to 7.8 s: overhead close plan holds with the gurney and round head shape parked at the doorway; the wall camera icon faces it with a lit lamp and faint view cones cross the floor. No hands or attendant.

Option b 8.0 to 8.8 s: overhead plan holds, then a cut at 8.6 s to an empty wall panel titled Room clock record under two lit wall cameras, in front of a skyline window. A small dark mark begins to form inside the panel.
Option b 9.0 to 9.8 s: a round clock draws itself inside the Room clock record panel and its hands sweep, under two lit wall cameras. No markers yet.

Option b 10.0 to 10.8 s: in the overhead plan the gurney with a patient is wheeled through the doorway past two attendants while a camera pulse marks the small wall clock with a tiny Patient entry tag. At 10.8 s a cut to a split: a Room clock record panel with the Patient entry row lit above a side view of three attendants at the table.

Option b 11.0 to 11.8 s: in the side view two attendants lay a teal drape over the patient as the Draped row in the Room clock record lights and receives a green marker under the Patient entry marker. At 11.8 s a cut to the overhead plan with the draped patient on the table.

Option b 12.0 to 12.8 s: in the overhead plan the draped patient is wheeled out through the doorway and the table shows a clean white top; a Turnover stamp is not legible at this scale. At 12.6 s a cut to a blue gloved hand holding a dark phone at a desk by the window.

Option b 13.0 to 13.8 s: the phone in the gloved hand lights up with a Text message header and To surgeon chip while, small in the background, the next patient is wheeled toward the table. Message body still blank.

Option b 14.0 to 14.8 s: the lit phone holds with a blank body while background figures transfer the next patient onto the table. At 14.8 s a split view puts the tiled room with three small attendants at the table on the left and the phone in a gloved hand on the right.

Option b 15.0 to 15.8 s: in the left half of a split, three small attendants lay a teal drape over the patient while the phone at right stays blank. At 15.8 s a close on the phone with a dotted amber arc from the wall camera; the message body is still empty.

Option b 16.0 to 16.8 s: an amber bubble reading Patient draped slides onto the phone and settles beside the dotted arc from the wall camera, with the draped patient visible small behind. The bubble's left edge sits clear of the thumb.

Option b 17.0 to 17.8 s: cut to a lined ledger pad on the desk; a small Hospital study card fades in and settles above an empty counter box labelled more surgeries a month. Chart labels are tiny at phone size.
Option b 18.0 to 18.8 s: fully static ledger frame with the study card (empty chart) and the empty counter box.

Option b 19.0 to 19.8 s: static ledger, then an overhead close of the Hospital study card with empty chart; the caption 'with other Houston Methodist sites' arrives and overlaps the counter label. No lines drawn yet.
Option b 20.0 to 20.8 s: the solid suite line and dashed comparison line draw across the card side by side and end with labels; the counter box stays empty and the caption overlaps its label.
Option b 21.0 to 21.8 s: static card, then a closer detail of the flat overlapping lines and the empty counter. The 'about 25 more' caption arrives at 21.8 s before any separation or count appears.
Option b 22.0 to 22.8 s: the suite line climbs away from the flat comparison line after the Cameras on rule; the gap fills teal while the counter below is still empty.
Option b 23.0 to 23.8 s: small teal tiles begin dropping into the counter box along a dotted line from the chart gap, about a dozen by 23.8 s; no numeral yet.
Option b 24.0 to 24.8 s: the counter completes a 5 by 5 grid of 25 tiles and a large 'about 25 more surgeries a month' appears beside it under the separated chart lines.
Option b 25.0 to 25.8 s: wide ledger view with the counter small at the top; a teal 7% rise badge stamps in beside it. Most of the frame is empty ruled paper.
Option b 26.0 to 26.8 s: static wide ledger with the small counter and 7% badge at the top; only a faint glow around the counter at 26.8 s.
Option b 27.0 to 27.8 s: the wide ledger holds; the counter glow fades and the caption clears at 27.8 s. No new element appears.
Option b 28.0 to 28.8 s: overhead close on the ledger with the counter, 'about 25' and a large 7% badge; a thin tick-marked axis labelled 95% confidence interval draws beneath them.
Option b 29.0 to 29.8 s: static frame of the counter, 7% badge and the empty labelled axis; no whisker appears.
Option b 30.0 to 30.8 s: cut to a close axis with the counter and badge cropped at the top edge; a teal cap lands at 8.3 and the whisker grows rightward with a white circular tip.
Option b 31.0 to 31.8 s: the whisker holds from 8.3 with a white circle near the middle and a lighter extension; no 41.0 cap in these samples.
Option b 32.0 to 32.8 s: the right end cap lands at 41.0 and a 'cases a month' chip settles below the completed interval, holding above the caption.
Option b 33.0 to 33.8 s: the interval holds, then a cut to a ledger page headed Placebo test; pale gray bars begin rising from a baseline at the left with staggered heights.

Option b 34.0 to 34.8 s: ten equal pale bars labelled Placebo runs stand on the ledger page and a teal Suite bar rises and slides in beside them at the same height. Bars are larger in frame than in option a.
Option b 35.0 to 35.8 s: closer static view of the equal bars with Placebo runs and Suite labels; no stamp has landed by 35.8 s.

Option b 36.0 to 36.8 s: a large wooden stamp presses and lifts, leaving a crooked amber 'SHORT OF CONVENTIONAL SIGNIFICANCE' impression across the bars; at 36.8 s a cut to a ledger page with a large Camera rollout tag.

Option b 37.0 to 37.8 s: a large card reading 'Associated with the rollout' with an Authors chip slides in from the left and settles above the large Camera rollout tag on the ledger. Both are legible at phone size.
Option b 38.0 to 38.8 s: static card and tag, then a wider overhead framing adds the 25-tile counter at right; a dash starts from the tag toward it.
Option b 39.0 to 39.8 s: a dashed teal link labelled associated draws from the Camera rollout tag to the 25-tile counter and holds. Elements are mid-sized and legible.
Option b 40.0 to 40.8 s: cut to a close of the dashed associated link reaching the counter; a solid black arrow labelled caused draws in from the left below it, not yet struck.
Option b 41.0 to 41.8 s: the solid caused arrow completes, then a diagonal stroke strikes it through and it grays out, holding below the dashed associated link to the counter.
Option b 42.0 to 42.8 s: the struck caused arrow holds about a second, then a cut to the wide ledger with a small stack of four workflow note cards whose labels are tiny at phone size.
Option b 43.0 to 43.8 s: a small Camera rollout tag slides in from the left and settles against the stack of four note cards on the wide ledger; both are small at phone size.

Option b 44.0 to 44.8 s: a close overhead on the large Camera rollout tag and the four legible review cards; a tan band slides across and lands as a horizontal Bundled strip over the tag and the Anesthesia review card, hiding the tag's label. It crosses one row rather than wrapping the stack.
Option b 45.0 to 45.8 s: the Bundled band holds across the rollout tag and the middle card with a buckle end at right; the tag's own label remains hidden.

Option b 46.0 to 46.8 s: a nearly blank ledger page holds for 0.4 s, then a Camera company / Apella Technology tag, an empty gray ownership ring and a Houston Methodist tag fade in, stacked vertically and legible.
Option b 47.0 to 47.8 s: static stack of the company tag, empty ownership ring and Houston Methodist tag; no slice lit while the stake caption runs.

Option b 48.0 to 48.8 s: a teal minority wedge lights on the ownership ring below the Apella tag and a dotted line links it to the Houston Methodist tag, with a Minority stake label fading in. Company, ring and holder stay in one frame. No number shown.
Option b 49.0 to 49.8 s: the completed stake diagram holds legibly with company tag, teal minority wedge, Minority stake label and dotted link to Houston Methodist.
Option b 50.0 to 50.8 s: stake diagram holds, then a cut to an empty ledger page where a Future work card with a highlighted Turnover time line lands.
Option b 51.0 to 51.8 s: beside the Future work card a room clock draws itself with rim markers and a green Turnover tag at the bottom.
Option b 52.0 to 52.8 s: close on the large clock with a Turnover tag; the Future work card is cropped to a sliver at left, where a small green pin appears; no full link to the marker yet.

Option b 53.0 to 53.8 s: a dashed tether runs from the Future work card's pin to the clock's turnover marker; at 53.8 s a cut to a wall panel holding the clock, a lit wall camera and a result card with the rollout tag, associated link and 25 counter.

Option b 54.0 to 54.8 s: identical to option a's close: a blank question box headed 'Did the rollout speed up turnover?' draws beside the clock, linked from the turnover marker, and collides with the wall camera at upper right.
Option b 55.0 to 55.8 s: the wall panel holds unchanged with the empty question box, clock and result card.

Option b 56.0 to 56.8 s: the turnover marker glows on the panel; at 56.8 s a cut back into the room with its four cameras, name plate, clock and window, while a ledger strip across the lower third carries the blank question box and the result card at legible size.
Option b 57.0 to 57.8 s: the room holds with the four lit cameras above and the ledger strip below; the room light dims slightly while the question box stays blank beside the result card.
Option b 58.0 to 58.8 s: the closing room composition holds with lit cameras, the blank question box and the result card; the caption clears at 58.8 s.
Option b 59.0 to 59.8 s: captionless static hold on the room with lit cameras and the ledger strip carrying the blank question box and the result card.
Option b 60.0 to 60.8 s: the same credits card as option a (identical page hash) fades in with flag icon, wordmark, URL and source, illustration and music credits.
Option b 61.0 to 61.8 s: credits card holds unchanged with flag icon, wordmark, URL and credits.
Option b 62.0 to 62.8 s: the same credits card holds without change.
Option b 63.0 to 63.8 s: the credits card holds without change.
Option b 64.0 to 64.8 s: the credits card holds without change.
Option b final frame 1947 at 64.9 s: the credits card is unchanged, with the flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL and the source, illustration and music credits.
